# Fadil R — AI-Driven Web Developer in Mauritius

> AI-augmented senior PHP / Symfony web architect and full-stack developer based in Mauritius. Hand me an idea — I architect, build, ship and deploy the product. 10+ years across web apps, SaaS, e-commerce, mobile apps, REST/GraphQL APIs and DevOps, now turbo-charged with AI tooling.

Also known as **fadilxcoder**. Available for freelance and remote contracts worldwide. Open to local Mauritius projects (Port Louis and remote).

The hook: **You explain the idea. I do the needful to develop and deploy it.**

## What I do

- **AI-driven development** — I use modern AI tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) to design, scaffold, refactor, test and ship production-grade code faster, without sacrificing quality.
- **AI integration into products** — connecting LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI), RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and assistant features into PHP / Symfony web apps.
- **PHP / Symfony full-stack** — Symfony 4-7, API Platform, Laravel / Lumen, CodeIgniter, hexagonal architecture, multi-tenant SaaS, custom micro PHP MVC (HFX).
- **Mobile apps** — Android via Flutter, Apache Cordova, Adobe PhoneGap; cross-platform PWA.
- **DevOps & cloud** — Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD with GitHub Actions and GitLab, monitoring, secure deployment.
- **End-to-end delivery** — from idea, architecture, build, test, deploy and maintain. One contact, full ownership.

## Who hires me

- Founders with an idea who need it shipped (MVP to production).
- Teams who want AI-augmented velocity without sacrificing code quality.
- Companies modernising legacy PHP stacks (Symfony 1/3 → Symfony 6/7, monolith → microservices).
- E-commerce shops needing PrestaShop or custom builds with Stripe / MCB payment integration.
- Mauritius businesses looking for a local, trustworthy senior dev who also delivers internationally.

## Tech stack

- **AI tools:** Claude Code, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, GitHub Copilot, Cursor
- **Languages:** PHP, Golang, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js
- **Backend frameworks:** Symfony, API Platform, Laravel, Lumen, CodeIgniter, FrankenPHP, custom micro framework (HFX)
- **Frontend:** Vue.js, React, Progressive Web Apps, HTML/CSS, Webpack, Babel, Laravel Mix
- **Databases:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch
- **Infra & DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bash scripting, Makefile
- **Mobile:** Flutter, Apache Cordova, Adobe PhoneGap, jQuery Mobile, Service Workers
- **Messaging & realtime:** RabbitMQ, WebSockets, Mercure, Firebase
- **Payments:** Stripe, MCB payment gateway
- **Auth & security:** OAuth2, JWT, Bearer tokens, custom encryption schemes
- **CMS / e-commerce:** WordPress (plugins), PrestaShop
- **Testing:** PHPUnit, Pest, Selenium

## Selected work

- **Real estate search engine** — PostgreSQL, Symfony 1, Symfony 4, API Platform, Golang microservices. Optimised system performance and DB queries. AWS S3, Azure, Apryse, Imagekit, Tilkee integrations.
- **Nutry.fr — SaaS for nutritionists** — Symfony 5 multi-tenant, MySQL, Stripe subscription billing, automated invoicing, HDS-certified secure hosting.
- **Training & MCQ exam SaaS** — Symfony 4 + MySQL platform for companies to deliver staff training, automated certificate generation.
- **E-commerce platform** — PrestaShop admin + Laravel Lumen shop + Symfony client + API proxy, ElasticSearch + Redis + MySQL. Migration toward Symfony 4.
- **Marketplace SaaS (in progress)** — FrankenPHP, Symfony 7, API Platform, React.js frontend, custom client-server encryption, Redis circuit breakers.
- **Streaming app** — Automated scraper exposing content via a centralised API, serving web and mobile clients.
- **GUI desktop & web tools** — SQLite-backed patient records app for doctors, dentist appointment system, custom Git GUI for QA testers.
- **PHP packages on Packagist** — 100K+ installs across published libraries.
